INSERT INTO items (name, item_type, description, effect_json, icon_url) VALUES ('Iron Sword', 'weapon', 'A reliable iron blade.', '{"attack":12,"slot":"weapon"}', null), ('Oak Bow', 'weapon', 'A flexible bow carved from oak.', '{"attack":9,"speed":3,"slot":"weapon"}', null), ('Apprentice Wand', 'weapon', 'Channels minor magic.', '{"magicPower":6,"slot":"weapon"}', null), ('Leather Boots', 'armor', 'Quiet footwear for nimble travel.', '{"defense":3,"speed":2,"slot":"feet"}', null), ('Steel Helm', 'armor', 'Protects the head in melee.', '{"defense":5,"slot":"head"}', null), ('Antidote', 'consumable', 'Cures poison and minor ailments.', '{"cure":"poison"}', null), ('Ether', 'consumable', 'Restores 50 MP.', '{"mana":50}', null), ('Phoenix Feather', 'consumable', 'Revives from defeat once.', '{"revive":true}', null);
-- Give character 1 a varied starting bag: 3 healing pots, 2 mana pots, 1 antidote, an iron sword (replaces nothing) INSERT INTO character_items (character_id, item_id, quantity) SELECT 1, id, 1 FROM items WHERE name IN ('Iron Sword','Antidote','Phoenix Feather','Ether') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM character_items ci WHERE ci.character_id = 1 AND ci.item_id = items.id );
